design_notes_global: All schemas follow JSON Schema draft 2020-12 with strict additionalProperties=false.
Monetary values stored as integer paise with display sibling _inr_text.
Subscription multiples stored as decimal strings with suffix _x.
Percentages stored as integer basis points with suffix _bps.
Dates stored as ISO 8601 strings with UTC offset.
Vendor extensions x-ipo-watch-* used for units, precedence, source tier, PII, and rule IDs.
Field provenance documented at schema level to track source contributions.
Enums use explicit enumDescriptions for clarity.
Identifiers: ISIN preferred, stable slug generated, aliases for renames.
Contamination risks mitigated by using integer types, patterns, and explicit units.
Schemas are modular with nested objects for related fields.
